title: Run full import, test, lint, and build validation
acceptance_criteria: The full web test suite passes with no skipped or newly weakened assertions.

The production web build passes without TypeScript errors.
The final implementation contains no stale PoC imports, Strength/Stretch-only assumptions, or evidence/source fields in the user-facing model.
